verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents running collections through the Postman CLI and Newman, and running test collections inside CI/CD pipelines. Nothing describes Postman monitors, recurring scheduled collection runs, or alerts when an API breaks. One-off or CI-triggered runs are a user-side workaround, not a first-party recurring schedule with alerting, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule collection runs as monitors that alert me when an API breaks
